content.value_statement: Architecture teams often lose time creating consistent technical documentation from scratch. This skill provides structured Markdown templates for architecture, API, deployment, and proposal documents.
actual_capabilities: Creates architecture design documents with background, principles, modules, data, deployment, security, and nonfunctional requirements.
Produces technical proposal structures covering technology choices, system flows, interfaces, implementation plans, and risks.
Drafts API design documents with protocols, authentication, versioning, endpoint tables, examples, and error codes.
Organizes deployment architecture details for availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, and alerting.
Includes sections for C4 context diagrams, container diagrams, architecture decisions, glossaries, and change histories.
limitations: Produces Markdown content but does not render PDF files.
Requires project requirements, constraints, and technology choices to replace template placeholders accurately.
Does not validate APIs, infrastructure configurations, performance targets, or security controls against a running system.
Provides diagram sections and textual guidance but does not generate graphical diagrams by itself.

use_cases.title: Document a New System
use_cases.description: Create a review-ready architecture specification for a new service, platform, or application.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Technical Proposal
use_cases.description: Compare technology choices and document interfaces, delivery stages, risks, and mitigation plans.

use_cases.title: Standardize API Documentation
use_cases.description: Define shared API conventions, endpoints, authentication, versioning, responses, and error codes.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Architecture Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an architecture design outline for [system]. Include goals, constraints, components, data, deployment, security, nonfunctional requirements, decisions, and open questions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a new architecture document with limited project details.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Technical Proposal
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a technical proposal for [project]. Compare [options] using requirements, tradeoffs, interfaces, delivery stages, operational risks, and mitigation measures.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a technology decision for engineering review.

prompt_templates.title: Design an API Specification
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an API design document for [domain]. Define protocols, authentication, versioning, resources, endpoints, pagination, errors, and representative request and response descriptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Align teams before API implementation begins.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Review-Ready Architecture Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a complete architecture package for [system] using the supplied requirements. Identify assumptions and unresolved decisions. Include C4 views, data flows, deployment, security, reliability, observability, migration, and ADR sections.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create an advanced document set for formal architecture review.

output_examples.input: Document a highly available order management service.
output_examples.output: A Markdown architecture specification covering service boundaries, order flows, storage, caching, availability targets, deployment topology, security controls, monitoring, risks, and decisions.

output_examples.input: Prepare a technical proposal comparing REST and gRPC for internal services.
output_examples.output: A structured proposal comparing compatibility, latency, tooling, operations, migration cost, and risks, followed by a recommendation and phased implementation plan.

output_examples.input: Design the API documentation for a product catalog.
output_examples.output: An API document defining authentication, versioning, product resources, list and detail operations, pagination, common errors, and readable request and response descriptions.

best_practices: Provide business goals, system boundaries, constraints, users, dependencies, and measurable nonfunctional requirements.
Replace every placeholder with verified project information and label uncertain details as assumptions.
Review generated decisions, security controls, diagrams, and operational targets with responsible specialists.
anti_patterns: Do not treat template defaults as approved architecture decisions.
Do not invent performance, availability, compliance, or recovery targets when requirements are missing.
Do not publish generated documentation without checking consistency against current code and infrastructure.

faq.question: Which document types can this skill create?
faq.answer: It supports architecture specifications, technical proposals, API designs, deployment architecture documents, and architecture decision sections.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide goals, scope, constraints, users, dependencies, technology choices, interfaces, data needs, and measurable quality targets.

faq.question: Can it generate a PDF?
faq.answer: No. It produces Markdown content and requires a separate PDF conversion tool.

faq.question: Can it create architecture diagrams?
faq.answer: It can define diagram sections and describe C4 views, but it does not render graphical diagrams.

faq.question: Does it verify the proposed architecture?
faq.answer: No. Engineers must validate feasibility, security, costs, performance, operations, and compliance.

faq.question: Can I use it for an existing system?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply current components, dependencies, deployment details, known constraints, and recent architecture decisions.
